propositions: Maintained guidance outside ADRs and migration records incorrectly describes current plan-review, completion-verifier, and verify-signature behavior as HMAC-based instead of asymmetric DSSE/SSHSIG

Docstrings and comments in sign_manifest, verify_signature, and attest.sign_plan_review must be corrected to reflect current asymmetric op-cert envelope shapes (principal, material_fingerprint, merged_log_commit, merged_log_material)
Documentation must state that legacy HMAC plan-review and completion-verifier records remain readable but cannot certify current gated operations
Generic HMAC helper functions (rebar.signing.compute_signature, verify_record) used by non-op-cert consumers must retain accurate API documentation and not be relabelled
Generated references (docs/mcp-reference.md, docs/cli-reference.md) must be regenerated through canonical scripts after docstring updates
Historical ADRs, migration records, and experiment corpora must remain unchanged while current-behavior paths are corrected
